name: The Nolan | Lizard Cowboy Boot
description: The Nolan is a versatile exotic cowboy boot, featuring genuine lizard leather hand-lasted in a timeless cowboy profile. An angled heel and signature Tecovas hand-corded calfskin shaft complete the elegant exotic profile. 12 inch shaft, 1 inch heel, round toe. Handmade men's lizard cowboy boot. Bourbon Lizard
